product_desc: A 14-inch laptop from the Dell Inspiron 7000 series, designed for compact elegance and versatile performance.

product_features.Display: 14-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS Truelife LED-Backlit Display
product_features.Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (integrated); some configurations also include NVIDIA GeForce MX150 dedicated graphics
product_features.Processor: 8th Generation Intel Core i5-8250U or Intel Core i7-8550U
product_features.Storage: Various configurations including 128GB SSD, 256GB SSD, and/or 500GB HDD
product_features.Operating System: Typically shipped with Microsoft Windows 10 Professional
product_features.Ports: Multiple USB ports (including USB 3.0 and USB 2.0) and HDMI output
